scene_description: A girl with long dark hair sits at a table writing in a notebook. A laptop is open on the table beside her. There are books on the table and artwork on the wall behind her.

questions.question: Who is sitting at the table?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person sitting at the table.

questions.question: What is the girl holding in her hand?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the girl's hand near the notebook.

questions.question: What is on the table next to the girl?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the table to the left of the girl.

questions.question: Where is the girl sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is underneath the girl and her books.

questions.question: What is the girl writing in?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what is open on the table in front of the girl.
